subject: disply the results of sex specific analysis

messages.author: 24a87515af049686
messages.subject: disply the results of sex specific analysis
parts:
HI Dr Karl and everypne,
I have encountered strange problem which I could not identify.
on displaying the out put of  scanone for sex specific analysis  I got Ersults on both male and female like this

max(out.m)
       chr  pos lod
SNP189   4 37.6 3.6
> max(out.f)
          chr pos  lod
c2a.loc57  2a  57 3.09

 but when I want to get summary of results, only the thresholds of male analysis is given even the female has suggestive qtl on any other chromosomes( like in this case chromosome 2).

summary (out.sexsp, perms=operm.sexsp, alpha=0.20, Pvalues=TRUE,  formate="allpeaks")
       chr  pos lod.males lod.females
SNP189   4 37.6       3.6        1.88

in other phenotypes when there is no evidence for qtl in males it give no detected threshold  even there is evidence for qtl in female.
> max(out.m)
          chr pos lod
c7.loc111   7 111 2.1
> max(out.f)
          chr pos  lod
c2a.loc54  2a  54 3.56
summary (out.sexsp, perms=operm.sexsp, alpha=0.05, Pvalues=TRUE,  formate="allpeaks")
    There were no LOD peaks above the threshold.


so I separate the female analysis to get the output
summary(out.f, perms=operm.f,  alpha=0.63, Pvalues=TRUE,  formate="allpeaks")
          chr pos  lod
c2a.loc54  2a  54 3.56
SNP174     3b 425 2.58
c4.loc24    4  24 3.24
c12.loc35  12  35 2.28
 and also no p value reported even I set the argument True.
why only male analysis is given in the output.
am I missing some thing here.
sorry for the long details.
Thank you
Bothaina Hassan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] disply the results of sex specific analysis
parts:
I think you need to use format=“allpeaks” rather than ‘formate’. If you don’t type the argument name exactly, it’s ignored.

karl

another question if you allow may.
I have many phenotypes with many qtls identified. I wish to plot each related phenotypes  with different colors and their lod scores and chromosomal position in one graph to use them in poster. Also I want to add threshold line at different levels say 5%, 10% and 63%. I searched through the manual and the book and cannot find any examples for this.
any help would be appreciated.
Thank you.
Bothaina Hassan
